item1_brouwer2021_KiDS1000_lensing_RAR.summary: Binned absolute lensing RAR obtained from the authors' public data release (ESD per g_bar bin) and converted to g_obs = 4 G DeltaSigma exactly as the README prescribes. 15 bins in g_bar = 1e-15..5e-12 m/s^2 (stars+cold gas point mass). KiDS isolated g_obs lies 0.02-0.19 dex above the M16/MOND fit with a0=1.2e-10 in 14 of 15 bins (compiler-derived). Paper: chi2_red vs MOND = 4.6 (15 bins), 4.0 (7 bins inside isolation limit), 1.5 / 14 for M* shifted +0.2 / -0.2 dex (7 bins); GAMA chi2_red = 0.8. Early types (red / n>2) have g_obs higher by 0.27 / 0.17 dex at fixed M*.

definitions.gbar: Newtonian acceleration of stars+cold gas treated as a point mass: g_bar = G*Mgal/r^2, Mgal = M*(1+f_cold); lens-source pairs are binned by their own g_bar (15 log bins 1e-15..5e-12 m/s^2). Listed x = bin midpoint, not lens-weighted mean g_bar.
definitions.gobs: SIS conversion g_obs = 4 G DeltaSigma (B21 Eq.7), computed by compiler from the data release per README with G=4.52e-30 pc^3 Msun^-1 s^-2, pc=3.086e16 m (factor 5.5795e-13 m/s^2 per Msun/pc^2) after dividing by bias (1+K)=0.98531.
definitions.errors: gobs_err_stat = 1-sigma statistical (shape noise, analytical covariance diagonal). NOT included: the 0.1 dex that B21 add to plotted RAR error bars for ESD->g_obs conversion (Sect. 4.4), the +-0.2 dex systematic stellar-mass band, and off-diagonal covariance (full covariance saved in brouwer2021_RAR_gobs_converted.json).
definitions.units: m/s^2 with h70=1 (H0=70); axis labels in B21 read [h70 m/s^2].
definitions.reliability: KiDS isolation reliable only for R < 0.3 h70^-1 Mpc, i.e. g_bar >~ 1e-13 m/s^2 (7.56e-14 for mean Mgal); lower-g_bar bins may be boosted (~30%) by missed satellites. GAMA (spec-z) considered reliable there.
